title: CRISPR Analysis Suite: Integrated gRNA Design and Indel Analysis
description: A comprehensive suite for CRISPR gRNA design, primer design, and indel analysis. Features both graphical and command-line interfaces for analyzing CRISPR editing outcomes from Sanger sequencing data.

creators.name: Your Last Name, Your First Name

notes: This software was developed for analyzing CRISPR editing outcomes in clonal cell lines using Sanger sequencing data.
references: Doench et al. (2016) Optimized sgRNA design to maximize activity and minimize off-target effects of CRISPR-Cas9. Nature Biotechnology
Moreno-Mateos et al. (2015) CRISPRscan: designing highly efficient sgRNAs for CRISPR-Cas9 targeting in vivo. Nature Methods
